# shadeform Provider

This is the independently maintained servescale fork, based on upstream v0.1.3.
The OpenTofu source is `servescale/shadeform`
(`registry.opentofu.org/servescale/shadeform`), with independent SemVer releases
starting at `v0.2.0`. See [available registry versions](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/servescale/shadeform/latest),
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/servescale/terraform-provider-shadeform/releases),
and the [installation instructions](../README.md#installation).
Existing upstream users must also follow the [state migration procedure](migration.md).
